Attached: 1 image

Before AI writes your emails, have it audit your week. List your 5 to 10 most repetitive weekly tasks and paste them into ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini. Ask which ones it can automate, the exact tools to use (free options first), beginner-level setup steps, and hours saved per week. Then have it total the hours and tell you which task to automate first. One prompt, personal automation plan, about a minute. #AI #Productivity #Automation
